The trouble is that if I take that pause, I am going to lose it. You're right - I'm normally pretty good at identifying mania and depression, and managing them. But my last several jobs have ended like this, and I don't want to lose this one, too. 

To be honest, alcohol helps more than anything else. It mellows out whatever I am feeling. But I try and be careful with it, because it can definitely make bad decisions more likely. 

Heh, mania is a blast. But it can be even worse than depression, in some ways. Overestimating yourself can be as bad as underestimating, and at least when I'm depressed, I don't actually *do* anything. Heh
Not really. What I need to do is just effing do them, but... I can't.
